datasets.title: Population by Province in 2010 in Papua New Guinea
datasets.description: The population was compiled from available census reports and validated using other available datasets. For each country, population counts from the finest resolution was trended to 2010 using a country-specific annual growth rate assumptions. Underlying vector geometry comes from regional sources, primarily SPC. Primary Data Source(s): SOPAC, National Statistics Office of Papua New Guinea Secondary Data Source(s): DIGO, University of Papua New Guinea Geographical Resolutions Available (with count): 1. Province (20) 2. District (87) 3. Local Level Government (297) 4. Census Unit (21,850) Additional Comments: 1. Census units are represented by a point location.
